```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)

# ---- USER SETTINGS ----
data_file <- here("Data", "All_SamplingScores", "Watershed_SupplementaryInformation_Final.csv")
# -----------------------

if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  stop("Data file not found. See the README for where to download it: ", data_file)
}

random_samples <- read_csv(data_file)
```

```{r}
SVI_quartiles <- random_samples %>% mutate(quartile = cut(
      OverallSVI_ArealInterpolated,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      labels = c(
        "Low: (0.0–0.25)",
        "Low - Medium: (0.25-0.5)",
        "Medium - High: (0.5-0.75)",
        "High: (0.75-1.0)"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ))
```

```{r}
SVI_quartiles$svi_binary <- factor(
  ifelse(Overall_SVI_samplingscore$Overall_SVI_Interpolated <= 0.5, "Lower vulnerability", "Higher vulnerability"),
  levels = c("Lower vulnerability", "Higher vulnerability"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

wilcox.test(Sample_Score ~ svi_binary, data = Overall_SVI_samplingscore, alternative = "greater")
```

```{r}
library(DescTools)
jt_result <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(
  x = quartiles$Sample_Score,
  g = quartiles$quartiles_ordered,
  alternative = "decreasing"
)

print(jt_result)
```
